blocks.text: For a moment, you might just forget you’re standing inside a shopping mall. The soaring ceiling could easily belong to an international airport, while the expansive 1-hectare indoor garden, bathed in beautiful natural light in a comfortable, airconditioned setting, brings to mind Singapore’s famed Gardens by the Bay. Yet this is SM Nuvali. In this highly anticipated, much -awaited flagship development of SM Supermalls in Laguna, an impressive integration of nature and technology promises to bring Filipinos a different kind of mall experience.
